To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the alkylation efficiency of a TFO-directed CPI can be greatly enhanced by using linkers that intercalate the DNA double helix and that the linker containing an acrydine ring is the most efficient.
the intercalation of aromatic rings in the linker of a triplex-forming DNA oligomer carrying a CPI reactive moiety greatly facilitates DNA alkylation.
the alkylation efficiency of TFO-directed alkylation of DNA is enhanced by the presence of an aromatic linker, and that the efficiency of the reaction increases in the presence of an intercalator.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and development of a novel approach for the site-directed alkylation of duplex DNA by a TFO.
the design of TFOs with a reactive moiety, which is able to alkylate DNA at a specific site, and the use of these TFOs for site-directed DNA alkylation.
the design, synthesis and evaluation of a series of linkers that can intercalate DNA to facilitate site-selective alkylation of duplex DNA by a TFO-directed CPI moiety.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the intercalation of the aromatic linker is a prerequisite for efficient site-specific alkylation of DNA by TFO-CPI conjugates.
the aromatic ring in a linker facilitates TFO-directed alkylation by CPI, but the linker itself does not have to be intercalating.
aromatic intercalators are necessary for efficient site-directed alkylation by CPI-bearing TFOs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the intercalating linkers greatly facilitate the DNA alkylation reaction.
aromatic rings in the linker enhance the site-specificity of alkylation by TFO-linked CPI.
the aromatic rings in the linkers facilitate alkylation by threading the DNA from the major to minor groove.
The main takeaway from our work is that
intercalation can be used to enhance the efficiency and specificity of DNA alkylation.
intercalating linkers can be used to enhance DNA alkylation reactions by TFO-directed CPI.
the intercalating linker can greatly enhance TFO-directed alkylation by a minor groove-bound CPI.
